name: Giovanni Pasquale Dibiasi
bioAdditions: The FamilySearch tree attaches four children to Giovanni Pasquale and Rosa Siconolfi: Domenico Antonio (1856), Maria Antonia (1870), Joseph (b. 18 Apr 1891) and Vincenzo 'James' (b. 2 Mar 1894). It cites no sources for him (S1). The two youngest cannot be theirs, because Rosa would have been 52–55. The April 1940 census shows Joseph DiBiasi (47, born Italy) and James DiBiasi (45, born Italy) as neighbours at 1015 Bunker Hill Street (S2). Three doors from the Petriello house, at 1022, lived a widowed Vincenzo DiBiasi, aged 74 (born c.1866), with his son Michael (S3). That Vincenzo is a more plausible father for Joseph and James, and possibly a younger son of Giovanni Pasquale himself, which would make him Maria Antonia's brother.

conflicts.assessment: Reject the FS additions: Rosa Siconolfi (b. c.1839) could not bear children in 1891/1894. Joseph married Grace Petrillo, Giovanni's own granddaughter.

openQuestionsNew: Was Vincenzo DiBiasi (b. c.1866, widower at 1022 Bunker Hill St in 1940) a son of Giovanni Pasquale and Rosa? His PA death certificate would name his parents.
